Reservoir.purpose: Time-series stock of a single physiological burden or asset (B_j per day per reservoir). Accumulates adverse inflows, decays toward a set-point at rate lambda_j, and is clamped to [0, B_max]. Burdens persist through missing data; tanks are never reset on stale input. Asset depletion (reserve falling below B_target) converts to risk via the B_tilde mapping in ReservoirSystem.

stories.want: accumulate sleep-debt burden across consecutive nights of deficit without resetting when a wearable reading is absent
stories.soThat: one good night or a gap in data does not falsely zero out a chronic SLD burden that should persist
acceptance: Given B_SLD > 0 and the nightly wearable reading is stale for 3 days, When the daily tick fires, Then B_SLD remains at its last persisted value minus only lambda_SLD*(B_SLD-B*) decay, never zeroed
Given a patient has 14 nights of deficit accumulating B_SLD, When one normal sleep night is recorded, Then B_SLD decreases by at most lambda_SLD*delta for that day, remaining significantly elevated
Given B_SLD is at B_max, When a new adverse inflow arrives, Then B_SLD stays clamped at B_max without overflow
edge: Stale marker uses last-known value with decayed confidence; inflow is not zeroed (anti-gaming, D19)

stories.role: clinician reviewing a managed hypertension patient
stories.want: see the VBP (vascular/BP load) reservoir reflect years of historical BP-time exposure even though current BP is controlled
stories.soThat: the atherogenic burden is honest about lifetime risk and is not cleared by treatment alone (D3)
acceptance: Given a patient has been on antihypertensives for 5 years with current systolic 125, When the reservoir is queried, Then VBP is > 0 reflecting prior exposure and slow lambda_VBP decay (years timescale)
Given the VBP reservoir is non-zero and the MANAGED tag is active on systolic BP, When the score is recomputed, Then VBP still contributes B_tilde to CV pillar risk
Given the patient stops antihypertensives and BP rises, When inflow_VBP reactivates, Then VBP climbs from its persisted non-zero base, not from zero
edge: lambda_VBP is near-zero (years scale); a single normal BP reading produces negligible drain relative to accumulated stock

stories.want: treat OXD (oxygen-delivery reserve) as an asset so depletion raises risk to HEM and CV pillars
stories.soThat: low hemoglobin or iron deficiency translates into elevated pillar risk even when no single marker crosses a critical threshold
acceptance: Given B_OXD drops below 50% of B_target due to low hemoglobin and low SpO2, When B_tilde_k is computed for HEM, Then the depletion term (1 - B_OXD/B_target) is > 0 and raises R_HEM
Given iron supplementation is started and ferritin rises over 8 weeks, When reservoir ticks daily, Then B_OXD increases toward B_target, reducing depletion risk on HEM and CV
Given B_OXD is at B_target (full reserve), When SpO2 transiently dips on a consumer wearable, Then inflow does not push B_OXD above B_max
edge: Asset polarity: depletion = risk; formula uses (1 - B_j/B_target) for u_{kj} link to pillar

stories.want: query a paginated daily time series of B_j for a given reservoir and patient over a date range
stories.soThat: the clinician dashboard and companion Trajectory dimension can display reservoir trend over time
acceptance: Given patient P has 90 days of SLD records, When GET /v1/patients/P/reservoirs is called, Then response includes B_j values, polarity, and trend direction for SLD
Given no measurements exist for a reservoir in a date range, When the series is queried, Then persisted prior values are returned with a 'stale_confidence' flag, not nulls
Given reservoir data is queried across a partition boundary (year), Then the response is contiguous with no missing rows
edge: Partition table by patient_id + year; index on (patient_id, reservoir_id, date DESC) for efficient latest-value lookups

table.name: reservoir_stock

columns.name: date
columns.note: one row per patient per reservoir per day (UTC)

columns.name: b_j
columns.note: stock value in [0, b_max]; clamped on write

columns.name: decay
columns.note: lambda_j*(B_j - B*) drain applied this tick

columns.name: confidence
columns.note: decayed confidence when input is stale

indexes: INDEX (patient_id, reservoir_id, date DESC) — latest-value fast path
table.notes: Append-only in production; updates only via the daily ReservoirSystem tick. A model-version bump requires a migration plan before backfilling history.

invariants: B_j is always clamped to [0, B_max]; no write may produce a value outside this range
Burdens persist through missing input data — stale inflow uses last-known value with decayed confidence, never zeros the tank (anti-gaming)
Asset depletion risk is (1 - B_j/B_target); a full reserve (B_j = B_target) contributes zero depletion risk
lambda_j is reservoir-specific and immutable within a model_version; slow-decay reservoirs (VBP, ATH, BON) retain stock for years
Each row is tied to a model_version_id; lambda/kappa/b_max changes require a model-version bump before re-ticking

ReservoirSystem.purpose: State stepper that applies one daily tick to all 15 canonical reservoirs for a patient: computes inflow_j, applies lambda_j decay toward set-point B*, folds in interference kappa_jl from other tanks, clamps results, and emits B_tilde_k for each pillar. Enforces Hurwitz stability (all eigenvalues of -Lambda+K negative) at every calibration. rho_k caps the total reservoir contribution to each pillar.

stories.want: step all 15 reservoirs forward by one day and propagate the resulting B_tilde_k values to PillarAggregator
stories.soThat: cross-pillar contagion (e.g. rising SLD raising INFL via kappa) is reflected in every daily recompute
acceptance: Given B_SLD is elevated and kappa_{INFL,SLD} > 0, When the daily tick fires, Then B_INFL increases by kappa_{INFL,SLD}*sat(B_SLD)*delta in addition to its own inflow
Given all 15 reservoirs are within [0, B_max], When tick completes, Then no reservoir value exceeds its B_max or falls below 0
Given calibration produces a (-Lambda+K) matrix with any eigenvalue having positive real part, Then the tick is rejected and an alert is raised to Governance before persisting
edge: Bidirectional coupling: kappa_{ALLO,SLD} > 0 and kappa_{SLD,ALLO} > 0; stepper must process all reservoirs in a single vectorized update, not sequentially, to avoid order-dependence

stories.want: cap each pillar's reservoir burden contribution at rho_k so a single very high reservoir cannot dominate PureScore
stories.soThat: the pillar risk function remains bounded and reservoir contributions remain proportional to other marker inputs
acceptance: Given B_GLY is at B_max and u_{MET,GLY} is high, When B_tilde_MET is computed, Then the contribution is clamped so rho_MET * B_tilde_MET does not exceed the rho_k cap defined in model constants
Given multiple reservoirs feed CV (ATH, INFL, VBP), When B_tilde_CV is computed, Then the combined u_{CV,j}*normalized(B_j) sum is clamped to [0,1] before rho_k multiplication
Given rho_k changes in a model-version bump, Then B_tilde for all pillars must be recomputed against the new cap before persisting
edge: rho_k is a versioned constant; a change triggers model-version bump and re-validation (D17)

stories.want: model a behavioural valve opening (e.g. completing a zone-2 cardio nudge) as a CRF reservoir inflow increase and a SLD drain acceleration
stories.soThat: the nudge's projected ΔPureScore@30d is computed honestly through the actual state equations, not a lookup
acceptance: Given an adherence event for 'zone-2 cardio' fires, When the valve is applied, Then B_CRF inflow increases by the valve's delta for that tick, and the projected B_tilde_FIT reduction is computed over 30 forward ticks

Given a patient with near-permanent ATH burden completes a lifestyle nudge, When the projection runs, Then ΔB_ATH@30d is near-zero (lambda_ATH tiny), and the nudge's ΔPureScore reflects this honest ceiling (D16)
Given two valves are applied simultaneously, When the stepper ticks, Then interference coupling means combined inflow changes are applied atomically in the same tick
edge: Valve efficacy is a signed delta on inflow_j or lambda_j; medication valves may modify lambda directly (e.g. statin reducing ATH inflow), not just behaviour

table.name: reservoir_system_snapshot

columns.name: tick_date
columns.note: date the full 15-reservoir tick was applied

columns.name: eigenvalue_min_real
columns.note: minimum real part of (-Lambda+K) eigenvalues; must be < 0 (Hurwitz check)

columns.name: stability_ok
columns.note: true iff all eigenvalues have negative real part

table.notes: Snapshot captures the B_tilde output vector for each tick. Individual B_j values live in reservoir_stock. If stability_ok = false, the tick must not be promoted to scoring.

invariants: All 15 canonical reservoirs must be stepped atomically in a single tick; sequential per-reservoir updates that observe partially-updated neighbours are forbidden
B_tilde_k for assets uses depletion term (1 - B_j/B_target); for burdens uses (B_j/B_max); combined link weight sum is clamped to [0,1]
rho_k caps the total reservoir contribution to pillar k; this cap is a versioned constant and may not be exceeded
The linearized system matrix (-Lambda + K) must have all eigenvalues with strictly negative real part (Hurwitz stability) before any tick output is persisted
kappa and lambda values may only change via a model-version bump followed by stability check and re-validation (D17)
Valve effects on inflow_j or lambda_j are applied within the tick they are registered; they do not retroactively alter prior stock values

CompanionVector.purpose: Per-pillar meta-dimension vector shipped alongside every PureScore. Rolls up ten dimensions: Confidence (Cf_k), Data Sufficiency (Su_k), Criticality (Cr), Trajectory/Momentum (Tr_k), Early-warning (Ew_k), Representativeness (Rp_k), Skew/Robustness (Sk_i), Volatility (Vo_k), Modifiability (Mo_k), and Stress-load (St). Stress-load is read-only and carries no PureScore weight (D24). Confidence and Sufficiency are distinct: sufficiency = data present; confidence = data trustworthy and stable.

stories.want: display a Confidence percentage alongside PureScore so users understand how much to trust the current number
stories.soThat: a score backed by one stale lab reads differently from a score backed by a full fresh panel, without hiding the number entirely
acceptance: Given a pillar has coverage 0.4, mean input confidence 0.7, and low volatility (stability 0.9), When Cf_k is computed, Then Cf_k = 0.4*0.7*0.9 = 0.252, displayed as 25%
Given a wearable-only pillar uses a consumer-validated device (tier discount applied), When Cf_k is computed, Then the per-input trust flag from D22 is propagated into meanConf_k, reducing Confidence
Given Su_k < 0.50 (tau_su threshold), When the companion is returned, Then the response includes an INSUFFICIENT flag on that pillar's sufficiency field
edge: A pillar can have Su_k = 1.0 (all data present) but Cf_k < 0.3 (noisy device); the two must be surfaced independently

stories.want: see Modifiability correctly distinguish my FH-driven CV risk (fixed) from my lifestyle-driven MET risk (modifiable)
stories.soThat: nudges are routed to clinician for fixed risk and to lifestyle actions for modifiable risk, with no false hope (D5, D16)
acceptance: Given CV pillar R_CV is 60% from ATH reservoir (near-permanent, fixed) and 40% from INFL reservoir (lifestyle-modifiable), When Mo_CV is computed, Then Mo_CV reflects the 40% modifiable share
Given a FH patient with ApoB driven by genetics, When the nudge engine checks Mo, Then ApoB's modifiable flag is false and the lifestyle action gate is closed, routing to a clinical recommendation
Given a patient improves diet and B_INFL declines, When Mo_CV is recomputed, Then the share of modifiable risk may shift as the relative contributions change
edge: Mo_k is a continuous share [0,1] not a binary flag; even near-permanent burdens have a small modifiable fraction from lifestyle coupling via kappa

stories.want: see Stress-load displayed prominently as a read-only companion chip without it affecting PureScore
stories.soThat: the patient's physiological stress context is visible for clinical interpretation without double-counting ALLO burden already inside CV/SLP/MCS pillars (D24)
acceptance: Given B_ALLO = 0.7*B_ALLO_max and z_auto (HRV depression + RHR elevation) = 1.5, When St is computed, Then St = 100*sigma(a*0.7 + b*1.5) and is returned in the companion vector with a tier label (elevated)
Given St = 95 (high tier), When PureScore is computed, Then the headline value is unchanged; St does not contribute to any pillar R_k or the gamma-weighted aggregation
Given the wearable providing HRV is consumer-tier (D22), When z_auto is computed, Then the HRV deviation is down-weighted by its tier factor before entering St, and Confidence on St is reduced
edge: St may raise EarlyWarning to Watch/Advisory and re-rank stress-reducing nudges, but it never sets or clears a band or triggers a critical (D24)

stories.want: receive a Trajectory arrow (improving/stable/worsening) per pillar with an estimated days-to-threshold forecast
stories.soThat: a patient whose PureScore is stable but trending down is alerted before a band is crossed, fulfilling the early-detection intent of D23
acceptance: Given S_CV has a robust negative slope of -0.3 units/day over a 14-day window, When Tr_CV is computed, Then the trajectory is 'worsening' and the estimated days to yellow is returned

Given a volatile pillar (Vo_k high) produces a noisy slope estimate, When Tr_k is computed, Then the slope is dampened by the volatility factor so short-term noise does not produce a misleading trajectory arrow
Given S_k crosses from yellow back into green over 3 consecutive reads, When Tr_k is updated, Then the direction flips to 'improving' with the rate
edge: Trajectory uses robust slope (e.g. Theil-Sen), not OLS, to resist outlier distortion from a single bad measurement

table.name: companion_vector_snapshot

columns.name: stress_load
columns.note: St 0-100; read-only companion, no PureScore weight

columns.name: stress_confidence
columns.note: propagated from wearable trust tier of autonomic inputs

table.notes: Written atomically with its paired PureScore snapshot. stress_load and stress_tier are surfaced to the patient app as a read-only chip. Per-pillar jsonb columns allow schema-free addition of new pillars without DDL changes.

invariants: Confidence and Sufficiency are always computed and stored independently; Su_k < tau_su triggers INSUFFICIENT flag regardless of Cf_k
Stress-load (St) is read-only: it has no weight in any pillar aggregation and cannot set or clear a band or trigger a critical cascade (D24)
Modifiability Mo_k must reflect the actual proportion of R_k attributable to modifiable inputs; fixed/genetic burden must not be reported as modifiable
Representativeness Rp_k below its floor suppresses the cohort-percentile blend in scoring and reduces Cf_k; it never adds a penalty
Volatility Vo_k damps both Cf_k and Tr_k so noisy signals cannot produce high-confidence trending arrows
The companion vector is always persisted alongside its PureScore snapshot; a score without a companion vector is invalid in production

EarlyWarning.purpose: Tiered anomaly ladder (Watch / Advisory / Alert) per pillar, implementing the D2 sensitivity posture. Watch is internal/clinician-only; Advisory is a gentle patient nudge; Alert requires clinical threshold breach or corroborated multivariate anomaly. Single-marker wobble never surfaces to the patient alone — it stays in Watch until multivariate- or multi-measurement-confirmed. Relies on personal-baseline z-scores, D_M (Mahalanobis aggregate), reservoir fill levels, and syndromic detectors.

stories.want: route a single isolated anomalous HRV reading from a consumer wearable to Watch only, never directly to Advisory or Alert
stories.soThat: normal athlete HRV variability and sensor noise do not generate patient-facing alarms (D2, D22)
acceptance: Given |z_HRV| > 2.0 on a single consumer-tier wearable reading with no corroborating markers, When EarlyWarning is evaluated, Then the tier is Watch (clinician queue only); the patient app receives no alert

Given the same HRV anomaly persists across 3 consecutive daily readings and is accompanied by elevated RHR z-score, When EarlyWarning is re-evaluated, Then the tier escalates to Advisory and a gentle nudge is surfaced to the patient

Given a beta-blocker patient has chronically suppressed HRV (confounder down-weighted per D3), When z_HRV is computed, Then the confounder weight c_conf reduces the effective z so the suppressed HRV does not trigger Watch
edge: Consumer-tier wearable anomaly alone can never reach Alert regardless of z magnitude; clinical-grade confirmation is required to escalate past Advisory (D22)

stories.want: detect early metabolic syndrome onset from simultaneous small z-score shifts in waist, HOMA-IR, TG, and HDL before any single marker crosses a band
stories.soThat: the multivariate Mahalanobis signal catches incubating disease that level-based scoring misses entirely
acceptance: Given waist z=1.4, HOMA-IR z=1.6, TG z=1.5, HDL z=-1.3 (all sub-threshold individually), When D_M = sqrt(sum zi^2) is computed, Then D_M > D_M* threshold and Advisory is triggered with the metabolic-syndrome syndromic detector label

Given the same patient has Rp_k (representativeness) below threshold for waist percentile (out-of-cohort), When EarlyWarning is computed, Then the suppressed cohort-percentile z for waist is excluded from D_M and Confidence on the Advisory is reduced

Given a patient's D_M crosses Advisory but all individual markers are within their personal green band, When the Advisory is surfaced, Then the explanation cites 'multivariate pattern' not a single marker breach
edge: D_M uses diagonal-covariance approximation in production v1 (D10); full Mahalanobis is deferred to a future model-version bump

stories.want: escalate a rising ALLO reservoir fill past its watch threshold to Advisory even before any questionnaire PSS/PHQ score crosses a clinical band
stories.soThat: accumulating allostatic burden is detected before it propagates into CV/MCS/SLP via kappa interference
acceptance: Given B_ALLO/B_ALLO_max > 0.6 over 5 consecutive days and z_auto (HRV + RHR personal deviation) > 1.5, When EarlyWarning evaluates the MCS pillar, Then EW_MCS escalates from none to Watch, and St (Stress-load) tier rises to 'elevated'
Given the ALLO reservoir Advisory fires, When the nudge engine runs, Then stress-reducing actions (sleep hygiene, mindfulness) receive a ranking boost via the St signal
Given B_ALLO normalizes over 10 days (PSS improves, HRV recovers), When EarlyWarning is re-evaluated, Then the tier descends back to none; there is no hysteresis lock-in
edge: St raising EarlyWarning Watch/Advisory is permitted; St must never set a band, trigger a critical, or move PureScore (D24)

stories.role: clinician receiving an SGLT2i-treated patient alert
stories.want: see a drug-expected eGFR dip routed to Watch with a reconfirm flag rather than triggering an Alert cascade
stories.soThat: anticipatable transient marker shifts from medication do not produce alarm fatigue (D3, D14)
acceptance: Given a patient starts SGLT2i and eGFR drops 8% (within drug-expected envelope), When the confirmation gate evaluates the REN pillar, Then EW_REN = Watch with tag 'drug-expected; reconfirm in 4 weeks', not Alert
Given the same patient's eGFR drops 25% (outside drug-expected envelope), When the gate evaluates, Then EW_REN escalates to Alert and the critical cascade fires

Given eGFR is flagged as artifact (hemolysis suspected, D14), When the confirmation gate runs, Then confidence is forced near-zero and the value cannot trigger Alert regardless of magnitude; Watch + reconfirm is surfaced
edge: A confirmed critical (high confidence, corroborated by a second marker or symptom) is never delayed by the drug-expected gate — safety dominates (D14)

table.name: early_warning_event

columns.name: pillar_code
columns.note: pillar this event is attached to; 'GLOBAL' for multivariate D_M

columns.name: trigger_detail
columns.note: z scores, D_M value, reservoir_id, syndrome label, etc.

columns.name: patient_visible
columns.note: false for Watch (clinician only); true for Advisory/Alert

columns.name: reconfirm_required
columns.note: true when artifact or drug-expected gate engaged

columns.name: companion_snapshot_id
columns.note: links to the companion vector that surfaced this event

indexes: INDEX (patient_id, tier, resolved_at) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL — open events fast path
table.notes: Watch events are stored but patient_visible = false; the patient app filters to Advisory and above. Alert events trigger the critical cascade and must be paired with a Governance escalation record.

invariants: A single-marker z-score anomaly alone may only reach Watch; Advisory requires multivariate D_M > threshold OR confirmed trend over >= 2 reads (D2)
A consumer or inferential wearable anomaly cannot reach Alert without clinical-grade corroboration (D22)
Drug-expected marker shifts are routed to Watch + reconfirm, never directly to Alert, unless the deviation exceeds the drug-expected envelope (D3, D14)

An artifact-flagged critical (low-quality, implausible) has confidence forced near-zero and cannot trigger Alert; a confirmed critical with full confidence is never held back by the artifact gate (D14)
Stress-load (St) may raise EarlyWarning to Watch or Advisory only; St cannot set an Alert or critical (D24)
Watch events are clinician-queue-only; patient_visible must remain false until the tier is Advisory or higher
Resolved EarlyWarning tiers descend without hysteresis: when triggering conditions normalize, the tier returns to none on the next evaluation
